# Game Idea: Canvas Dodge

- **Genre:** Arcade/Survival
- **Core mechanic:** Player controls a shape with arrow keys, navigating an HTML5 canvas while avoiding continuously spawning obstacles (e.g., circles) that drift in random directions.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible; points increase over time.
- **Lose condition:** Collision with any obstacle ends the game.

1: // Simple Canvas Dodge game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width;
12:   const height = canvas.height;
13: 
14:   // Player configuration
15:   const player = {
16:     x: width / 2,
17:     y: height / 2,
18:     size: 20,
19:     speed: 4,
20:     color: '#00ff00',
21:   };
22:   // Trail of recent positions for visual effect
23:   const trail = [];
24: 
25:   // Input handling
26:   const keys = {};
27:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => (keys[e.key] = true));
28:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => (keys[e.key] = false));
29: 
30:   // Obstacles
31:   const obstacles = [];
32:   const obstacleSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
33:   const obstacleSpeed = 2;
34:   const obstacleSizeRange = [10, 30];
35:   let lastSpawn = 0;
36: 
37:   // Game state
38:   let score = 0;
39:   let startTime = null;
40:   let gameOver = false;
41: 
42:   function spawnObstacle() {
43:     const size = Math.random() * (obstacleSizeRange[1] - obstacleSizeRange[0]) + obstacleSizeRange[0];
44:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
45:     const speedX = Math.cos(angle) * obstacleSpeed;
46:     const speedY = Math.sin(angle) * obstacleSpeed;
47:     const x = Math.random() * width;
48:     const y = Math.random() * height;
49:     obstacles.push({ x, y, size, speedX, speedY, color: '#ff5555' });
50:   }
51: 
52:   function update(dt) {
53:     // Move player
54:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
55:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
56:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
57:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
58:     // Keep player within bounds
59:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, player.x));
60:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, player.y));
61: 
62:     // Record trail
63:     trail.push({ x: player.x, y: player.y });
64:     if (trail.length > 12) trail.shift();
65: 
66:     // Spawn obstacles over time
67:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > obstacleSpawnInterval) {
68:       spawnObstacle();
69:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
70:     }
71: 
72:     // Update obstacles
73:     for (const o of obstacles) {
74:       o.x += o.speedX;
75:       o.y += o.speedY;
76:       // Wrap around edges
77:       if (o.x < -o.size) o.x = width + o.size;
78:       if (o.x > width + o.size) o.x = -o.size;
79:       if (o.y < -o.size) o.y = height + o.size;
80:       if (o.y > height + o.size) o.y = -o.size;
81:     }
82: 
83:     // Collision detection
84:     for (const o of obstacles) {
85:       const dx = o.x - player.x;
86:       const dy = o.y - player.y;
87:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
88:       if (dist < o.size + player.size / 2) {
89:         gameOver = true;
90:         playBeep();
91:         break;
92:       }
93:     }
94: 
95:     // Update score
96:     if (!gameOver) {
97:       const now = performance.now();
98:       score = Math.floor((now - startTime) / 1000);
99:     }
100:   }
101: 
102:   function draw() {
103:     // Background
104:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
105:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
106: 
107:     // Draw trail
108:     for (let i = trail.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
109:       const p = trail[i];
110:       const alpha = (i + 1) / trail.length * 0.4; // fade out
111:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,255,0,${alpha})`;
112:       ctx.beginPath();
113:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, player.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
114:       ctx.fill();
115:     }
116: 
117:     // Draw player with radial gradient
118:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(player.x, player.y, player.size / 4, player.x, player.y, player.size / 2);
119:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#bfff00');
120:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#006400');
121:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
122:     ctx.beginPath();
123:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
124:     ctx.fill();
125: 
126:     // Draw obstacles with size‑based hue
127:     for (const o of obstacles) {
128:       const hue = Math.round((o.size - obstacleSizeRange[0]) / (obstacleSizeRange[1] - obstacleSizeRange[0]) * 120;
129:       ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 80%, 60%)`;
130:       ctx.beginPath();
131:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
132:       ctx.fill();
133:     }
134: 
135:     // Draw score
136:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
137:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
138:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
139: 
140:     // Game over overlay
141:     if (gameOver) {
142:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
143:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
144:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
145:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
146:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
147:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
148:     }
149:   }
150: 
151:   function loop(timestamp) {
152:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
153:     const dt = timestamp - (lastRender ?? timestamp);
154:     lastRender = timestamp;
155:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
156:     draw();
157:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
158:   }
159:   let lastRender;
160:   // Sound state
161:   let soundPlayed = false;
162:   // Simple beep using Web Audio API
163:   function playBeep() {
164:     try {
165:       const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
166:       const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
167:       const gain = ctx.createGain();
168:       osc.frequency.value = 220;
169:       gain.gain.value = 0.2;
170:       osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination);
171:       osc.start();
172:       osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
173:     } catch (e) {
174:       console.error('Audio not supported', e);
175:     }
176:   }
177:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
178: })();

(End of file - total 178 lines)
</content>
